psychological_meaning: Everglade evokes feelings of tranquility, growth, and stability. It is associated with nature, representing lush forests and serene landscapes. This color promotes a sense of peace and connection to the earth, fostering a feeling of harmony and balance. It can also symbolize resilience and endurance, like the enduring strength of a forest.
